description: Background PAINTERS and the signature Verification-Scan MOTIF. Eight lightweight CustomPainters (low opacity, repaint-throttled, pause offscreen/on reduced-motion, sit below content) plus the reusable VerificationScan widget+painter (1-2px luminous hairline sweep, corner-marker lock, staggered ~40ms OCR box fade-in; reduced-motion -> static locked end state). Depends on FEAT-001 tokens/motion. Grounded in plan.md Painters and Motif sections.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/veriqoo-design-system-phase1/context.json and plan.md (Painters + Motif sections) FIRST.

Create a shared pause/reduced-motion helper (mixin or AnimatedBuilder gated by an `enabled` flag + VeriqooMotion.reduceMotion) so painters stop animating when disabled/offscreen or reduced-motion is on.

Create painters/inspection_grid.dart (InspectionGrid), painters/scanning_line.dart (ScanningLine), painters/ocr_overlay.dart (OCROverlay), painters/data_ticker.dart (DataTicker ticking 'OCR 98.2%','FIELD DETECTED','VERIFYING','DECLARATION FOUND'), painters/product_outline.dart (ProductOutline), painters/verification_pulse.dart (VerificationPulse), painters/compliance_markers.dart (ComplianceMarkers), painters/technical_coordinates.dart (TechnicalCoordinates). All monochrome, low opacity, correct shouldRepaint.

Create motif/verification_scan.dart: VerificationScan widget + painter implementing the signature sweep + corner-marker lock + staggered OCR box fade-in, consuming VeriqooTokens colors; reduced-motion renders the final locked state with no animation.
Add export lines for all painters and the motif to design_system.dart.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 painters and VerificationScan exist, are monochrome, and respect reduced-motion / pause-when-disabled.
design_system.dart exports the painters and motif.
findings:
All in packages/shared_core/lib/design_system/, exported from design_system.dart. `flutter analyze` in shared_core = 0 issues (baseline was already clean).

SHARED BASE (painters/background_effect.dart): `abstract class BackgroundEffect extends StatefulWidget` with ctor params {Key? key, bool enabled=true, Color? color}. Its `BackgroundEffectState<T>` owns ALL pause logic: stops+holds at end state (progress=1) when enabled=false OR VeriqooMotion.reduceMotion(context); offscreen pause is automatic via TickerMode muting the AnimationController; repaint is throttled by quantizing progress into `repaintSteps` discrete steps (default 90). color defaults to Theme VeriqooTokens.textPrimary (fallback offWhite). Also exports `abstract class BackgroundPainter extends CustomPainter {double progress; Color color;}` with a ready-made shouldRepaint; subclass painters only implement `paintEffect(Canvas, Size)`. Reuse this base for any further animated background decorations.

EIGHT PAINTER WIDGETS (each is a BackgroundEffect subclass widget; the CustomPainter is private in-file): InspectionGrid({enabled,color,double cell=32}), ScanningLine({enabled,color}), OCROverlay({enabled,color}), DataTicker({enabled,color}) with static `DataTicker.labels` = ['OCR 98.2%','FIELD DETECTED','VERIFYING','DECLARATION FOUND'], ProductOutline({enabled,color}), VerificationPulse({enabled,color,int rings=3}), ComplianceMarkers({enabled,color,double spacing=72}), TechnicalCoordinates({enabled,color}). All monochrome, opacity <=0.14, sit BELOW content (use e.g. a Stack with the painter first / Positioned.fill below the content layer). They size to Size.infinite, so give them bounded constraints (gallery preview boxes).

MOTIF (motif/verification_scan.dart): `class VerificationScan extends StatefulWidget` ctor = VerificationScan({Key? key, Widget? child, List<ScanField> fields=VerificationScan.defaultFields, bool enabled=true, bool loop=true, Duration duration=1600ms, Duration stagger=40ms, Color? color, double cornerLength=18, double sweepThickness=1.5}). `child` (camera preview / data panel) is painted BENEATH the scan overlay via a Stack. loop=false plays once then holds the locked end state. reduced-motion/enabled=false => static locked end state (corners locked, all boxes visible, NO sweep). Public helper type `class ScanField {Rect rect (normalized 0..1); String? label;}` — pass custom fields+labels. Public `class VerificationScanPainter extends CustomPainter` is exported too (progress/color/fields/staggerFraction/cornerLength/sweepThickness) if a component needs to paint it directly. VeriqooLoading should wrap `VerificationScan(loop:true)`; VeriqooScannerOverlay should pass the camera preview as `child` plus its own ScanField list with labels. 'Luminous' sweep uses a MaskFilter.blur glow underlay (no gradient shader) to honor the no-gradients rule.
